CRISP-DM
Six phases, one loop
CRoss-Industry Standard Process for Data Mining
Starts and ends with the business, not the model
Iterative: arrows go back as well as forward
Click to walk through each phase
PHASE 1 OF 6
Business Understanding
What decision are we trying to improve?
Define objectives & success criteria
Assess resources, constraints & risks
Turn it into an analytical goal
OUTPUT
Project plan
PHASE 2 OF 6
Data Understanding
What data do we have, and can we trust it?
Collect the initial data
Describe and explore it
Verify data quality
OUTPUT
Data quality report
PHASE 3 OF 6
Data Preparation
Is the data ready for modelling?
Select and clean the data
Construct new features
Integrate and format sources
OUTPUT
Final modelling dataset
PHASE 4 OF 6
Modeling
Which technique best captures the pattern?
Select modelling techniques
Design the test (e.g. train / test split)
Build, tune and assess models
OUTPUT
Candidate models
PHASE 5 OF 6
Evaluation
Does it actually meet the business goal?
Judge results against business criteria
Review the process for gaps
Decide: deploy, iterate or stop
OUTPUT
Go / no-go decision
PHASE 6 OF 6
Deployment
How does it get used, and stay healthy?
Plan the roll-out into the business
Monitor and maintain performance
Final report and project review
OUTPUT
Live solution + monitoring plan
